text_description: Full runway look centered on a dramatic black-and-ivory midi dress with sculptural, asymmetric proportions. The upper body has a pale ivory fitted bodice with narrow shoulder straps, partially overlaid by a wide black off-the-shoulder folded band that drops over the upper arms like short draped sleeves; the black overlay forms a deep V shape at the neckline and continues into an elongated vertical loop or keyhole-like panel down the center front. The waist and hip area are defined by irregular black draped panels that wrap and flare outward, creating a layered peplum effect over a fuller black skirt. The skirt falls to mid-calf with uneven, ruffled, tiered construction and a high-low, softly voluminous hem, especially visible on the left side. The palette is high-contrast black and ivory, with the black sections appearing matte and fluid but structured enough to hold folded edges and sculptural curves. Styling includes a chunky gold chain necklace at the collarbone and bright green textured or lace-like pointed footwear peeking from beneath the skirt, adding a vivid color accent to the otherwise monochrome dress.
